title: Menstrual Hygiene Day school talk and dignity-pack drive
theme: Dignity, health and education for every girl
summary: Members visited a local school for an open conversation on menstruation with girls and boys. A myth-versus-fact game broke the silence, and girls received dignity packs with sanitary towels and soap.

title: World Environment Day tree planting
summary: Members and pupils planted indigenous seedlings around a school compound and talked about caring for the land and water we share.

title: Day of the African Child celebration
theme: Ensuring Universal Access to Water, Sanitation and Hygiene for Every Child in Africa
summary: Children, parents and teachers marked the day with a mentorship talk, a menstrual health session, a handwashing demonstration, talent performances and tree planting.

title: Founding meeting and election of officials
summary: Members formally established Enkaji Enkitati CBO, adopted the constitution and elected the executive committee led by Chairperson Caren Naeku Dapash.

title: First table banking (VSLA) meeting
summary: Members agreed the savings and loan rules, chose meeting days and bought their first shares, starting the group's first savings cycle.

title: International Youth Day forum
summary: Young people joined a forum on leadership, digital skills and starting small businesses.

title: Ignite Dreams primary school mentorship visit
summary: Our mentors led sessions on dreaming big and the importance of education, with questions and a dream-wall activity where pupils wrote their goals.

title: Beadwork and business skills workshop
summary: Women beadworkers learned pricing, simple record-keeping and ways to reach new buyers for their products.

title: International Day of Rural Women
summary: An exhibition of women's products and a savings group training session. Partners and buyers are welcome.

title: 16 Days of Activism Against GBV
summary: Community awareness walks and school outreach on ending gender-based violence and FGM.

title: International Volunteer Day
summary: Thanking our volunteers and welcoming new ones. Come and find out how you can help.
